preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output is a positive integer representing the maximum journey length, which cannot exceed the string length.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(ti) < len(ti - 1) for i in range(2, k)) and all(ti in s for i in range(1, k + 1)) and all(ti in s[j:j + len(ti)] for i in range(1, k + 1) for j in range(len(s) - len(ti) + 1)) and all(s.find(ti, j) < s.find(ti + 1, j + len(ti)) for i in range(1, k) for j in range(len(s) - len(ti) - len(ti + 1) + 1))
postconditions.description: There exists a journey t1, ..., tk of length k such that each ti is a substring of ti-1, strictly decreasing in length, and all ti appear in s in left-to-right order without overlap.

postconditions.expression: not any(k + 1 <= int(stdout) <= n for k in range(1, n + 1) if all(1 <= len(ti) < len(ti - 1) for i in range(2, k + 1)) and all(ti in s for i in range(1, k + 1)) and all(ti in s[j:j + len(ti)] for i in range(1, k + 1) for j in range(len(s) - len(ti) + 1)) and all(s.find(ti, j) < s.find(ti + 1, j + len(ti)) for i in range(1, k) for j in range(len(s) - len(ti) - len(ti + 1) + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible journey length for the given string s.
